sample_unit: parameter-level outputs (50 device configurations x 8 parameters x 3 chatbots)

links.outcome: Accuracy of chatbot-retrieved MRI safety parameters versus manufacturer documentation
links.effect: Pooled parameter-level accuracy was 0.94 (ChatGPT), 0.79 (Gemini), and 0.78 (Claude); ChatGPT-5.6 pilot accuracy was 0.98. Errors persisted even with the best chatbot.
links.quote: Errors occurred even with the best-performing chatbot, requiring direct verification against current manufacturer documentation before clinical use.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy of LLM chatbots in retrieving implant MRI safety conditions against manufacturer reference standards; does not test a deployment practice or safeguard.
